STS2WD-REALTA_BRONZE_WATCHDOG.title: Bronze Watchdog
STS2WD-REALTA_BRONZE_WATCHDOG.descriptio: At the start of each combat, [gold]Guard[/gold] {Guard}.
STS2WD-REALTA_KUU.title: Kuu
STS2WD-REALTA_KUU.description:
At the start of each combat, [gold]Guard[/gold] {CombatStartGuard}.
At the end of your turn, if you have any unspent Energy, return all [gold]Steel Guardians[/gold] to your hand from anywhere.
STS2WD-REALTA_WITCH_POINTED_HAT.title: Witch's Pointed Hat
STS2WD-REALTA_WITCH_POINTED_HAT.descript: The first time you trigger a [gold]Spell[/gold] effect each combat, gain {Energy} Energy.
STS2WD-REALTA_DRAGON_CLOAK.title: Dragon Cloak
STS2WD-REALTA_DRAGON_CLOAK.description: At the start of each combat, gain {VigorPower} [gold]Vigor[/gold] and {FlameBarrierPower} [gold]Flame Barrier[/gold].
STS2WD-REALTA_ELDIR_GRAMR.title: Eldir Gramr
STS2WD-REALTA_ELDIR_GRAMR.description: Whenever you consume [gold]Vigor[/gold], deal the same amount of damage to ALL enemies.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_WYRD.title: Wyrd
STS2WD-ALTHEA_WYRD.description: Your Strikes also count as Curses and have Retain.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_BLOOD_FRENZY.title: Blood Frenzy
STS2WD-ALTHEA_BLOOD_FRENZY.description: All your Attacks also count as Curses and have Retain.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_FIGHTERS_BRACER.title: Fighters Bracer
STS2WD-ALTHEA_FIGHTERS_BRACER.descriptio: Gain 6 Block at turn end until you reshuffle this combat.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_ANCESTORS_RECOGNITION.desc: Before the initial draw, move Curses from your draw pile to your discard pile.
STS2WD-ALTHEA_CREKIN_MAC_DUBH.title: Crekin Mac Dubh
STS2WD-ALTHEA_CREKIN_MAC_DUBH.descriptio: Vulnerable increases your damage taken by 20%, and Frail reduces your Block by 20%.
